_note: THIS BOARD IS CONDITION-ONLY AND SAYS SO. Its own name reads
'Insert · dragging — CONDITION-ONLY — leaves on drop/dragend, no control
(GroupSection.tsx:189-190; ELEMENTS rows only)'. Dragging an Insert row
changes NOTHING inside the panel: `handleDragStart` (useBuildTab.ts:187-194)
writes two dataTransfer entries and returns. No class, no fill, no ghost of
its own, no row removed. So there is no dragging STATE for a step to reach
and no dragging PROPERTY for the diff to compare, and the recipe measures
the panel the board actually draws — which is the default panel.
THE CONDITION IS VERIFIED SEPARATELY, and these are this pass's numbers,

six `dragover` ticks across the canvas, then `dragend`, driven over this

FOUND, NOT FIXED — carried from the board's own title, re-read in the code
this pass and still true. These are DROP-path defects, all outside the
Insert panel and all behaviour, so no visual pass settles them:
useDropExecution.ts hardcodes a success result while `handleBlockDrop`
re-reads `e.dataTransfer` after an await and gets '' — a drag can place
nothing and be reported as having worked (board's UX-A-01).
dragCalculations.ts computes the valid/invalid indicator for a generic
container rather than for the thing being dragged (UX-A-19).
the drop path has no needs-asset branch, so a DRAGGED Image lands with no
src while a CLICKED Image opens Media first (UX-A-18).
